description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) for four different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) configurations as the number of queries used during inference increases from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)", is linear and spans from 1 to 10, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled "MRR@10", is linear and ranges from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. The plot displays four lines: a black solid line for "DPR w/o query" that remains constant at approximately 34.4; a red line with circular markers for "DPR w/ corpus expansion" that starts at approximately 34.7, rises to a peak of 35.6 at S=2, and then remains relatively stable around 35.7; a green line with triangular markers for "DPR w/ document expansion" that starts at approximately 34.7, fluctuates slightly, and ends at approximately 34.7; and a blue line with star markers for "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" that starts at approximately 34.7, dips to a low of 34.4 at S=6, and then declines further to approximately 34.3 at S=10.
